transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: Server approval requests publish interaction:permission-requested. tool is a method table name or the method string. presentation is native-tui when there is no decide handler and the method is shared; otherwise host-ui.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: A host decision publishes allowed or denied. serverRequest/resolved settles unknown and does not carry the decision. Transport close and dispose also settle unknown.

transforms.name: adapter-step-2
transforms.effect: A non-shared request with no decide handler resolves denied.
